terms.comment: Distinguish mālus, mālī m., a ship’s mast, and malus, bad.

phrases.latin: Est in hortō mālus vetus, rāmīs humilibus et patulīs
phrases.english: In the garden there is an old apple tree with low, spreading branches

phrases.latin: Spectā mē, Baba! Quam longē saluī!
phrases.english: Look at me, Baba! How far I jumped!

sources: Lewis & Short: malus
